title: THE SLIDE: three heaving lunges to the stone, and he hauls himself up against its edge
note: His last tentacle sinks; forward 4.24 tiles in 4 s, the water heaped before him; his heaps grip the stone's back edge (it cracks, water surging over); his eye drooped low over the stone, within reach.
items: x2: the edge cracking, water surging over

title: SHIELDED: the three pillars burning, their lines into him, his ward; a blow glancing off it
note: The siege's pink fire at each obelisk's point, its line crawling into him; his ward round him while any burns, flashing where a blow meets it.
items: burning, its line into him; his ward
x2: the blow glancing off his ward

title: THE SIEGE'S BOLTS: three every 2.6 s, warned 1.1 s, the first on the Warrior
note: The warnings crawling, flaring gold as the bolts fall out of the sky (in front of him, clear of him); the strike bursting; the stone scorched.

title: THE WARD-STONE: lying, picked up, set into the left pillar: put out
note: The friend's cyan: the piece glinting where it lies, held at his side, set into the pillar's foot; its fire guttering out, its line going dark toward him.

title: THE RIGHT PILLAR BROKEN: twelve blows at its foot
note: Each blow cracks it further; the twelfth: it cracks across and topples outward into the water in three pieces, splashing; its line snaps back into him.

title: THE LAST PILLAR OUT: his ward broken
note: A piece set into the near pillar's foot; the last fire dies; his ward cracks and shatters off him. Now he can be hurt; the bolts are done.

title: THE EYE SLAM, JUST CLEAR
note: The wind-up held 0.93 s, the warning on the Warrior; slammed down 1.5 tiles round on frame 28, the stone cracking, slime flung; lying to 2.2 s; dragged back up by 2.8 s.

title: THE EYE SLAM, STRUCK AS IT LIES
note: Leapt clear, then in at it as it lies: two blows, its dark ichor; it jolts where it lies, and lies on.

title: THE GAZE FROM HIS NEW PLACE
note: His eye rears up out of its droop; the arc laid 32 degrees each side of the Warrior from the stone's back edge; the beam swept across the stone; out at 2.4 s.

title: HIS EYE STRUCK
note: A blow at his eye as it weaves low over the edge: a big flinch, its lids clenched, its dark ichor (never cyan).
